mapper.select: select count(*) from inquiry where (deleted = 0 or deleted is null) and (#{status} = 'ALL' or answer_status = #{status})

select i.inquiry_id, i.created_at, i.type, u.name, u.nickname, i.title, i.answer_status, i.content from inquiry i left join user u on i.user_id = u.user_id where (i.deleted = 0 or i.deleted is null) and (#{status} = 'ALL' or i.answer_status = #{status}) order by i.inquiry_id desc limit #{row}, 10

select i.inquiry_id, i.type, i.title, i.content, i.user_id, i.created_at, i.answer_status, i.answer, i.answered_at, u.name, u.nickname from inquiry i left join user u on i.user_id = u.user_id where i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
mapper.update: update inquiry set answer = #{answer}, answered_at = now(), admin_id = #{adminId}, answer_status = '답변완료' where inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
